title: The tail left behind
hook: A lizard may escape by losing a part.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The diagram marks a break point and then shows the tail separated. Some lizards can shed a tail as a defense; survival is not guaranteed, and a later regrown tail need not match the original.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A predator grabs the tail of a lizard with a natural tail break point. What can some lizards do?

claims.text: The detached tail is drawn below the starting tail to indicate a later state, not two tails on one animal.
What does autotomy mean in a lizard-tail example? Tail autotomy is the shedding of a tail at an existing break point.
